title: Great cast iron skillet, perfect for a single cook to use!
text: Great cast iron skillet, perfect for a single cook to use!. This is the first time I have ever used a cast iron stove top skillet and I have to say I am quite impressed. I had a rib eye steak that I was intending to use my gas grill for, but instead opted for my stove top. I am absolutely amazed at how evenly the steak cooked and I loved the grill marks that the grooves left on the steak (looks like it was grilled). In addition, I can see the health benefits of allowing the fat to stay away from the meat. Clean up was a relative breeze as well. If I had any complaints at all it would be in the size. This is a handy size for a single person to cook solo meals on. However, if I was looking to make pancakes for my grandkids, this would never be able to pass the test only cooking about 2-3 pancakes at a time. I am going to look for a larger version to keep around for weekend family meals.

product_metadata.title: Sabatier Pre-Seasoned Rust Resistant Cast Iron Single Reversible Grill/Griddle, 10-Inch
features: This reversible grill/griddle is constructed of cast iron using chemical-free technology that creates an all-natural surface that is durable, non-porous, rust-resistant, and stick-resistant for easy cleanup
Featuring a reversible cooking surface, use the griddle side to cook bacon or grilled cheese and the grill side for hamburgers or steaks
Compatible with most heat sources, including induction, and ceramic top ranges; oven safe to 500 degrees F, and can also be used in the oven, under the broiler, or on the grill
Heat is absorbed evenly and spreads gently for superior heat retention while cooking; for use with a single burner
Dishwasher friendly or hand wash then dry immediately; rub with a light coat of oil after every wash
description: This Sabatier Pre-Seasoned Rust-Resistant Cast Iron Single Burner Reversible Griddle offers a flat surface and a grill surface for cooking everything from pancakes to burgers right on your stovetop. Constructed of cast iron using technology that creates an all-natural surface that is durable, non-porous, rust-resistant, and stick-resistant for easy cleanup. The new surface technology is not a coating, is chemical-free, and is safe to use with metal utensils. Compatible with most heat sources, including gas and ceramic top ranges. It absorbs heat evenly and spreads it gently for excellent heat retention while cooking, is oven safe to 500 degrees F, and can also be used in the oven, under the broiler, or on the grill. Measures 10 x 10 inches. Dishwasher friendly .

After each wash, rub the entire pan with a light coat of oil. Use enough oil to restore the sheen, without making the pan “sticky." Oiling the pan after each wash will help keep the iron “seasoned” and protected from moisture.
